gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma patient with definitive resection prior to enrollment

candidate_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] MT-201-GBM monocyte vaccine: monocytes isolated from patient's leukapheresis loaded with CMV pp65-LAMP (Lysosomal-associated Membrane Protein) mRNA (Messenger Ribonucleic Acid)
The investigational vaccine (MT-201-GBM) in this study is made from a type of immune cell called monocytes, which have been engineered to express a cytomegalovirus (CMV) protein.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma patient with definitive resection prior to enrollment

agents.agent_name_registered: temozolomide (TMZ; standard of care, not a registered intervention)

role_evidence.quote: Patients will receive a total of 3 intravenous vaccines every 4 weeks after completing standard radiation therapy (XRT) and temozolomide (TMZ) and a single course of dose-intensified TMZ.

flag.reason: A single course of dose-intensified TMZ precedes the vaccine; it is described as part of the background schedule rather than the subject of investigation, so coded soc_backbone rather than established_therapy_experiment.

source_quote.quote: MGMT promoter unmethylated (Determined by Caris Life Science pyrosequencing)

coder_notes: Only experimental intervention is an autologous monocyte cell vaccine loaded with CMV pp65-LAMP mRNA (cell therapy / cancer vaccine), an excluded intervention type. Temozolomide is background only. The MT-201-GBM vaccine is not listed in agents because it is not a drug or biologic eligible as a pharmacological agent; adjudicator may wish to add it as a registered biologic.
